newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TARTU DEPARTMENT STORE PLANS EXPANSION-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TARTU DEPARTMENT STORE PLANS EXPANSION-REPORT.

text.p: Tartu Department Store is planning to expand its facilities by the year 2000, the Aripaev business newspaper said on Wednesday.
The new complex in what is already the largest department store in southern Estonia would have a floor space of 6,000 square meters, the newspaper said.
Tartu Department Store is majority owned by Tallinna Kaubamaja and a minority stake is held by the Tartu Consumers Co-operative which also owns the land for the future expansion site, the paper said.
The sale price for the land needed for the expansion has not been agreed as yet, the paper added.
